task.title: Add a note to a person
task.shortdesc: Write down something you know about a person that does not fit in a date or a place.

prereq.p: Open the page of Maria Branwell first. shows how.

context.p: A note is your own writing, kept with the person's record. This page adds a note to Maria Branwell.

step.cmd: Choose in the part that starts , then choose .

info.p: The list scrolls. Turn the mouse wheel with the pointer on it to find the part.

stepresult.p: A form opens with one big box for the note.

step.cmd: Type your note in the box named .

info.p: For example, Maria Branwell came from Penzance in Cornwall. She married Patrick Brontë in December 1812 and died at Haworth in September 1821.

step.cmd: Choose in the menu to read it.

stepresult.p: The page lists the note by its first words.

result.p: The note belongs to that person. On a record, a button that starts with Notes and a number in brackets, such as Notes (1), counts its notes.
result.note: Write what you know, and say where you read it if you can.

postreq.p: The same page has the buttons and . To use one note for several people, see .
